about: Hand-maintained. One record per model family, keyed by the first path segment under /models/ in models-manifest.json. Each record is what the publisher states, copied from the model cards and from the fetch scripts under scripts/fetch-*-models.ts. It is a record of their words and not a clearance: Lolly does not say a model is safe to use for any purpose. converterLicence is an SPDX id or name when the party that made the ONNX files states one, 'none-stated' when its repository states no licence, 'not-recorded' when this repository never recorded what the converter states, and 'not-applicable' when the files are used as the publisher released them or were converted by Lolly. acceptRequired is true when the publisher's terms carry use restrictions that the person should see before the download. offerLine, when present, is the English sentence Profile and the in-place offer show before the download.

sing.licence: OpenRAIL-M (Supertonic-3); Apache-2.0 (wav2vec2 vocabulary); none stated (rondocode-sing files)
sing.note: Supertone's OpenRAIL-M licence has use-based restrictions that bind anyone using the weights; its LICENSE.txt travels with the files. The rondocode-sing repository states no licence and no provenance for the phoneme, ContentVec and voice-generator files, and the two int8 Supertonic builds were made by rondocode's author. Hosting them was a deliberate choice made with that known.
sing.offerLine: Supertonic-3 is under OpenRAIL-M; the voices’ source states no licence.

upscale.note: The licence recorded is the upstream project's, read from its own repository. A community converter can attach different terms to its repository; those were not recorded here and are re-checked on each pin refresh.
